threads.body: The committed reduction is not reproducible: both Crew kickoff span names contain run-generated UUIDs, and findings preserve `signal_name` verbatim. A fresh conformance run will generate different Crew IDs and rewrite these findings, while `AGENTS.md:59-60` requires `data.json` to match reruns. Stabilize or normalize the Crew IDs/span names, then regenerate this file.

threads.body: CrewAI's `~=1.42.0` OpenTelemetry constraint admits 1.42.1, and that SDK provides semantic-conventions 0.63b1. This makes instrumentation 0.62.3 compatible.
